items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played with us for a year and more with our cornet.

ctx.x: Yeah. Would he play a little variation softly or would he get up and be featured?

Not at first. He didn't know he was very bashful. In fact, he never played for a white person before he played on the Capitol. He was playing in the Economy Hall with Oliver Norris at the time. We knew him and we went down to hear him and he was so outstanding. We tried to hire him but he wasn't on board the board on the town playing with white people. So we had Will get him. And he didn't have a cornet or he just known as a cornet. So we had a cornet on the boat and we loaned it to him. He played with us for a…
I don't think I've ever heard of an Organo poem.
